steps.title: Save an extension that handles jira.example issue links and shows the last one in its section
cmux: clear; D="${CMUX_CUSTOMIZE_DIR:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/cmux/customize}"; mkdir -p "$D" && echo  | base64 -d > "$D/main.js" && echo  | base64 -d > "$D/cmux-app.json" && echo saved the link handler

steps.title: A terminal prints an issue link
Cmd-click the link: the extension opens it (its section and toast), not the browser
Save the manifest with a tracker.example pattern: no relaunch
cmux: clear; D="${CMUX_CUSTOMIZE_DIR:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/cmux/customize}"; mkdir -p "$D" && echo  | base64 -d > "$D/cmux-app.json" && echo saved: issue links now come from tracker.example

steps.title: A terminal prints a tracker link
Cmd-click it: the edited pattern routes it to the extension at once
